citizenship_quote: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

qualifications.quote: A basic understanding of material science fundamentals is preferred, though not required.
Hands-on lab experience is required.
The ideal candidate is highly skilled in setting up, operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting laboratory equipment.
High school diploma or equivalency certificate
1+ years of hands-on materials testing experience in a laboratory setting
Knowledge of safe work practices in a lab environment with solvents, acids/bases, thermal protection systems, polymers, etc.
Experience with thermal instruments (TGA, DMA, DSC, etc.)
Experience with mechanical test frames (Instron, MTS, etc.)
Understanding of basic materials science fundamentals
Positive attitude and experience working on a cross-functional team
Experience setting up and running tests and experiments
Maintaining rigorous attention to detail when executing test instructions
Strong computer skills including experience with Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook), Atlassian JIRA, and work order systems
Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills to work closely with engineering group
Ability to read and understand test specifications
Strong organizational skills to keep work area tidy and organize workflow
Creative approach to problem solving, with willingness to learn and try new things
Experience using various types of hand tools and/or power tools
Able to work off-shifts and available for overtime and weekends if needed
Able to wear appropriate PPE for lab and machine shop environment
Able to lift a minimum of 50 lbs. unassisted.

notes: ITAR line requires U.S.-person status (citizen/national, LPR, refugee, asylee) with an escape clause for those eligible to obtain State Department authorization; labeled citizenship_required=true because it is a stated, unconditional applicant requirement, but the escape clause makes this debatable. Three pay ranges are per level (Level 1-3), all hourly. 'material science fundamentals' treated as an academic field, not a skill. Instron and MTS are test-frame equipment brands; kept as hardware/tool skills, reviewer may drop them as companies. Tensile/fatigue/compression testing extracted from a parenthetical list under 'mechanical testing'; SDT read as simultaneous thermal analysis (TA Instruments SDT). Review: ITAR line removed from qualifications to match the owner's g03 call (it still drives citizenship). Added lab safety, hand tools, power tools.
